verses.1: Mauv sinned in Israel after the death of Ahav.
verses.2: And Ahaz fell from his throne, at the top of his tower. He became sick, and he sent out demons to torment him. He said to them, “Go and ask the god of Ekeron for a cure for this illness.”
verses.3: And the Lord spoke to Elijah, saying, “Get up and go to King Shomeron. He will speak to them. There is no god in Israel; you are going to worship a god of perverts.”
verses.4: And so, as Jehovah said, “The ladder that you climbed there shall not descend from there. For death will reign there.” And Eliyah went away.
verses.5: And the demons returned to him. He said to them, “What is this that you have done?”
verses.6: And they said to him, “A man has come to call upon us. He told us to go back to the king who sent you there. He said to you, ‘The LORD says: There is no god in Israel. You are sent to preach to a people who are worthless. So, do not go back there; do not leave that place, for death will come to you.’”
verses.7: And he spoke to them about what the man who came to meet with you had said. He told them these things.
verses.8: And they said to him, “A man with a beard and a beard of hair on his head.” He said, “May I sit down?”
verses.9: And he sent fifty and five men to him. They went up to him, and behold, he was sitting on the top of the mountain. And a man from God spoke to him. It was the word of the Lord.
verses.10: And Elijah answered and said to the priest of fifty: “If you are a man of God, then I will send fire down from heaven to eat you and your fifty men.” And fire indeed came down from heaven and ate him and his fifty men.
verses.11: And he sat down and sent for another fifty officials. They came and spoke to him. A man from God said to him, “Quickly, get up!”
verses.12: And Elijah said to them, “If I am the messenger of God, then fire will descend from heaven and eat you and your five brothers. But if I am not the messenger of God, then let it happen.” And so, fire indeed descended from heaven and ate him and his five brothers.
verses.13: And he sat down, and he sent out the fifty-third official. He went up and came down. The fifty-third official knelt before him, facing Israel. He prayed to him, and a man from God spoke to him: “Please save my soul and the souls of your servants. These fifty people are under your control.”
verses.14: Look! Fire came down from heaven and ate up the two first of the fifty lambs. Now, my soul is destroyed in your eyes.
verses.15: And the angel of the LORD spoke to Elijah. He said, “Do not be afraid before him.” Then he got up and went down to the king.
verses.16: And He said to him, “Thus says the LORD: Because you sent messengers to inquire about the man of God. There is no god in Israel who can answer questions like these. Therefore, the ladder you built there will not be able to descend from there; for you will surely die.”
verses.17: And he died according to the word of the LORD. Jehoram became king after him, in the second year of his reign. Jehoram was the son of Jehosafat, king of Judah. He had no sons.
verses.18: And the additional words of Ahaziah, which he did, are recorded in the book of the days of Israel’s kings.
